findings.rule: Both exact case-sensitive Contains("[em") guards bypass all settings access when absent. Both return zero emphasis records and leave text unchanged. All126 target and1103 arc-first prefix strings lack this substring. Serialized emphasis settings are unnecessary for this bounded conditional result. This does not establish actual manager/display objects: Parse reads instance.displaySettings.subtitleSettings.richTextEmphases BEFORE helper entry.

Guarded regex is literal \[\/?em[1- plus settings.Length.ToString() plus ]\]. This is a character class, not a general integer range. Evaluator parses the penultimate one-character digit, subtracts1; when in settings bounds, creates Emphasis(0,Int32.MaxValue,color,bold,italic,underline), clears the entire list and adds that one record. Opening/closing distinction and match positions are ignored. Every regex match returns empty. The last valid marker, including a closing marker, therefore determines the single whole-text record. No broad bracket stripping, trimming or actual renderer range claim. Zero/multidigit setting-count regex behavior is not certified by the single-digit synthetic adapter.

For each setting index in ascending order, constructs exact [emN]/[/emN]. Only if that opening token is present, replaces all its openings with optional , optional , then ; replaces closings with , optional , optional . No pairing/nesting validation or underline output; unmatched closing-only index is retained. Returns a new zero-length Emphasis array. Tag-only text can become nonempty markup in this branch while extraction makes it empty. Unknown other rich text remains exact.

Original format is #{0:x2}{1:x2}{2:x2}{3:x2}, channels RGBA multiplied by255 then conv.i4. Controls supply an already formatted webColor rather than replacing this with unverified Python float/Unity conversion. No source-scoped [em means this helper is never required on that conditional path.

Constructor normalizes null text to String.Empty and null emphases to static noEmphases, then assigns properties through direct backing-field setters. Text/rich markup/whitespace are not trimmed or otherwise transformed. All scoped Parse outputs supply nonnull zero-length emphasis arrays. [a] is passed as italic; f/auto/noSubtitle, position, panel and pic indices retain prior prefix values.

The unchanged target text Right, love! <pause>Fen actually helped us explore some of our kinks as well! retains literal <pause> through both emphasis helpers and the constructor. No renderer/typewriter handling, naturalness, translation or successful display is certified. Arc bracket prose131:153 and540:232 also survives.
